version.author: S.Hansen / Tycho
version.changelog: Initial public ReaPack package for Reflex v20.665. Requires ReaImGui 0.10+ and SWS Extension; FX Window Toggle requires js_ReaScriptAPI.

version.author: S.Hansen / Tycho
version.changelog: Fix Windows ReaImGui Remote child boundary assertion after manual cursor layout.

version.author: S.Hansen / Tycho
version.changelog: Hide Remote by default, draw Reflex arrows font-independently on Windows, and update embedded Navigator mirror phase.

version.author: S.Hansen / Tycho
version.changelog: Fix Navigator range selection parity, add Armed View helper actions, and preserve Navigator state in history.

version.author: S.Hansen / Tycho
version.changelog: Embed Reflex theme defaults, remove the external theme file, and fix right-dock gap compensation.

version.author: S.Hansen / Tycho
version.changelog: Bring embedded Reflex Navigator rendering in line with standalone Track Navigator: sticky search, smart TLT clipping, and history-aware tree changes.

version.author: S.Hansen / Tycho
version.changelog: Add draggable Navigator/Inspector split, fix embedded Navigator arrow rendering, and restore normal non-ReaperTips dock gaps.

version.author: S.Hansen / Tycho
version.changelog: Refine Reflex scaling, footer controls, Navigator assets, and flow-card outlines.
